﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) for the position of (لا) and its noun, since their position is the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); or a badal for the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿رب العرش الكريم﴾: (رب) is a third adjective; (العرش) is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (الكريم) is an adjective of (العرش).

muyesser-irab:117-117.t:
﴿ومن يدع مع الله إلها آخر﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (من) is a conditional mubtadaʾ (subject); (يدع) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), in the jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; (مع) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يدع﴾, and the Name of Majesty is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إلهًا) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يدع﴾; and (آخر) is an adjective (naʿt).
﴿لا برهان له به﴾: (لا) is the lā of generic negation; (برهان) is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; ﴿له﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (لا); and the clause ﴿لا برهان...﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a second adjective of ﴿إلهًا﴾; it is an inherent adjective, brought for emphasis. Or it is parenthetical between the protasis and its apodosis, and so has no grammatical position.
﴿فإنما حسابه عند ربه﴾: the fāʾ links the consequence of the condition because the clause is nominal; (إنما) is a restraining particle and the one it restrains (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (حسابه) is a mubtadaʾ; the adverb (عند) is attached to the omitted khabar of (حسابه); (ربه) is the muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of (من); and the clause ﴿ومن يدع مع الله...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿إنه لا يفلح الكافرون﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿لا يفلح﴾ is the khabar of (إنه); and (الكافرون) is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:118-118.t:
﴿وقل رب اغفر وارحم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (قل) is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); (رب) is the one addressed in the vocative, [annexed] to the first-person yāʾ, which is omitted; (اغفر) is a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ), and (ارحم) is conjoined to it; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وأنت خير الراحمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (أنت) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (خير) is the khabar (predicate), and it is muḍāf; ﴿الراحمين﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿قد أفلح المؤمنون﴾: قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); أفلح is a past verb; and المؤمنون is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿الذين هم في صلاتهم خاشعون﴾: الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿المؤمنون﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); في صلاتهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خاشعون﴾; خاشعون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿والذين هم عن اللغو معرضون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is conjoined to الذين; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); عن اللغو is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿معرضون﴾; معرضون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿والذين هم للزكاة فاعلون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is conjoined to الذين; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and فاعلون the khabar (predicate); للزكاة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فاعلون﴾, فاعلون being made to include the meaning of "those who pay"; and it is also said: the lām is a connective (ṣila) particle on the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because it is placed before its governor.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿والذين هم لفروجهم حافظون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is conjoined to what precedes; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and حافظون the khabar (predicate); and لفروجهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حافظون﴾.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿إلا على أزواجهم﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; ﴿على أزواجهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حافظون﴾ by making it include the meaning of "withholding", or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being in charge".
﴿أو ما ملكت أيمانهم﴾: أو is a conjunction; ما is conjoined to أزواجهم; and the clause ملكت أيمانهم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فإنهم غير ملومين﴾: the clause gives the cause of the exception; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and غير ملومين its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿فمن ابتغى وراء ذلك فأولئك هم العادون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-inducing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ابتغى is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he". ﴿وراء﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa), and this omitted word is the object of ابتغى, i.e. "seeks something that lies beyond that"; or وراء means "other than", and so is accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ذلك is muḍāf ilayhi. The conditional clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أولئك is a mubtadaʾ, ﴿هم﴾ a second mubtadaʾ, and العادون a khabar, the clause being the khabar of أولئك; or هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) and العادون is the khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿والذين هم لأماناتهم وعهدهم راعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is conjoined to what precedes; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and راعون its khabar (predicate); لأماناتهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿راعون﴾; and عهدهم is conjoined to أماناتهم.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿والذين هم على صلواتهم يحافظون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is conjoined to what precedes; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); على صلواتهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحافظون﴾; the clause يحافظون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; and the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين. [Translator's note: so in the source; given that الذين is said to be conjoined to what precedes, the nominal clause would be its ṣila (relative clause), as in the previous ayahs.]

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿أولئك هم الوارثون﴾: أولئك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and الوارثون the khabar (predicate); or ﴿هم﴾ is a second mubtadaʾ and الوارثون its khabar, the nominal clause being the khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿الذين يرثون الفردوس هم فيها خالدون﴾: الذين is a second khabar (predicate), or an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿الوارثون﴾; the clause يرثون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; الفردوس is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خالدون﴾; خالدون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause هم فيها خالدون is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿ولقد خلقنا الإنسان من سلالة من طين﴾: the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to an omitted oath. خلقنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); الإنسان is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من سلالة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلقنا﴾, من being for the starting point; ﴿من طين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of سلالة, or attached to سلالة because it has the sense of "drawn out", من being explicative (bayān); and the speech is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t: ﴿ثم جعلناه نطفة في قرار مكين﴾: ثم is a conjunction; جعلناه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); نطفة is a second mafʿūl bihi; في قرار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted third mafʿūl bihi; and مكين is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ثم خلقنا النطفة علقة﴾: ثم is a conjunction; خلقنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); النطفة is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and علقة a second mafʿūl bihi, because خلقنا includes the meaning of "We made into".
﴿فخلقنا العلقة مضغة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; خلقنا is a verb and its fāʿil; العلقة is the first mafʿūl bihi, and مضغة a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فخلقنا المضغة عظاما﴾: فخلقنا is a verb and its fāʿil; المضغة is the first mafʿūl bihi, and عظامًا a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فكسونا العظام لحما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كسونا is a verb and its fāʿil; العظام is the first mafʿūl bihi, and لحما a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ثم أنشأناه خلقا آخر﴾: ثم is a conjunction; أنشأناه is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; خلقًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and آخر an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿فتبارك الله أحسن الخالقين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; تبارك is a past verb; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil; أحسن is a badal (substitute) from ﴿الله﴾; الخالقين is muḍāf ilayhi; the tamyīz (specification) of أحسن is omitted because it is known, i.e. "in creating"; and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿ثم إنكم بعد ذلك لميتون﴾: ثم is a conjunction (of sequence) with delay; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and ﴿كم﴾ is its noun; ﴿بعد ذلك﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or to ﴿ميتون﴾; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ميتون is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿ثم إنكم يوم القيامة تبعثون﴾: conjoined to what precedes; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and ﴿كم﴾ is its noun; يوم القيامة is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تبعثون﴾; تبعثون is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause تبعثون is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿ولقد خلقنا فوقكم سبع طرائق﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. The lām is the response to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); خلقنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); فوقكم is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلقنا﴾; سبع طرائق is the object of خلقنا, and طرائق is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وما كنا عن الخلق غافلين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb (of kāna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; عن الخلق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿غافلين﴾; and غافلين is the khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وأنزلنا من السماء ماء بقدر فأسكناه في الأرض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنزلنا is conjoined to خلقنا; من السماء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلنا﴾; ماء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بقدر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ماء, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun; فأسكناه is conjoined to أنزلنا, and it is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi; and في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اسكناه﴾ [Translator's note: so spelled in the source, for «أسكناه»].
﴿وإنا على ذهاب به لقادرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; على ذهاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قادرون﴾; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ذهاب﴾; قادرون is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿فأنشأنا لكم به جنات من نخيل وأعناب﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أنشأنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنشأنا﴾; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿أنشأنا﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the bāʾ being for accompaniment (mulābasa); جنات is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من نخيل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of جنات; and أعناب is conjoined to نخيل.
﴿لكم فيها فواكه كثيرة ومنها تأكلون﴾: لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; فواكه is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); كثيرة is an adjective; منها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأكلون﴾; تأكلون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; and the clause ﴿لكم فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from جنات, or an adjective. [Translator's note: so worded in the source, which calls the clause ﴿لكم فيها﴾ "a preposition and its genitive noun"; what seems meant is that the clause is a ḥāl from جنات or an adjective of it.]

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿وشجرة تخرج من طور سيناء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; شجرة is conjoined to جنات; the clause تخرج is an adjective (ṣifa) of شجرة; and من طور سيناء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تخرج﴾.
﴿تنبت بالدهن وصبغ للآكلين﴾: the clause is a second adjective of شجرة; ﴿بالدهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "bound up with oil and accompanied by it"; صبغ is conjoined to الدهن; and للآكلين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of صبغ.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وإن لكم في الأنعام لعبرة نسقيكم مما في بطونها﴾: the wāw: a conjunction. إن: an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters). ﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾. في الأنعام: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and عبرة: the noun of إن. نسقيكم: an imperfect verb, the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the kāf: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿نسقيكم﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. مما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نسيقكم﴾ [Translator's note: so spelled in the source, for «نسقيكم»]. في بطونها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ولكم فيها منافع كثيرة ومنها تأكلون﴾: ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; منافع is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); كثيرة is an adjective (ṣifa); منها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأكلون﴾; تأكلون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿لكم فيها ...﴾ is conjoined to نسقيكم, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿منها يأكلون﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the ayah has «تأكلون»] is conjoined to ﴿لكم فيها منافع﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وعليها وعلى الفلك تحملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; عليها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تحملون﴾, the pronoun referring back to the camels, which are among the livestock; تحملون is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause ﴿وعليها﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿نسقيكم﴾.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿ولقد أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. The lām is the response to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); نوحًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿إلى قومه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾.
﴿فقال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره أفلا تتقون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; قال is a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he"; يا is a vocative particle; قوم is the one addressed, annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; ﴿اعبدوا﴾ الله is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ما is negating; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; ﴿إله﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) in position, genitive by من in form; غيره is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿إله﴾ according to its position; the clause ﴿ما لكم من إله غيره﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and functions as the reason for the command to worship. The hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ conjoins to something implied, i.e. "Do you disobey, and so not fear (Him)?"

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿فقال الملأ الذين كفروا من قومه ما هذا إلا بشر مثلكم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿قال الملأ﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of الملأ; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; من قومه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ما هذا is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ما is negating; هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); بشر is the khabar (predicate); and مثلكم is an adjective.
﴿يريد أن يتفضل عليكم﴾: the clause يريد is an adjective; ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is the object of يريد; and ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتفضل﴾.
﴿ولو شاء الله لأنزل ملائكة﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or resumptive; شاء الله is a verb and its fāʿil; the object of the willing is omitted, understood from the content of the apodosis of لو, i.e. "had He willed to send down a messenger"; the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; the clause ﴿أنزل ملائكة﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a jussive condition [Translator's note: so in the source, «شرط جازم»; لو is a non-jussive conditional, and elsewhere the book says «غير جازم»]; and the clause ﴿ولو شاء الله...﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ما سمعنا بهذا في آبائنا الأولين﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ما is negating; سمعنا is a verb and its fāʿil; بهذا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سمعنا﴾; ﴿في آبائنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; and ﴿الأولين﴾ is an adjective of آبائنا.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿إن هو إلا رجل به جنة﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. إن is negating; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); رجل is the khabar (predicate) of هو; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; جنة is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of رجل.
﴿فتربصوا به حتى حين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), i.e. "if you want to make clear the truth (of the matter), then wait"; or the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. تربصوا is an imperative verb, i.e. "wait", and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تربصوا﴾; حتى is a particle of limit and of the genitive; حين is genitive by ﴿حتى﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to ﴿تربصوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿قال رب انصرني بما كذبون﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position. رب is the one addressed, annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; انصرني is a verb of supplication; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The bāʾ is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with the agent after it [Translator's note: so in the source, «مع الفاعل بعدها»; what is meant is the verb after it] as a maṣdar genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "because of their denying me", the bāʾ thus being causal; or for substitution, i.e. "help me in exchange for their denying me"; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿انصرني﴾.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿فأوحينا إليه أن اصنع الفلك بأعيننا ووحينا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. أوحينا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). إليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحينا﴾. ﴿أن﴾: explicative, because revelation contains the meaning of saying without its letters, and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, and together with what it enters upon it is interpreted as a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أوحى﴾; and the clause ﴿اصنع﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. اصنع: an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you". الفلك: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بأعيننا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun concealed in ﴿اصنع﴾. ووحينا is conjoined to أعيننا.
﴿فإذا جاء أمرنا وفار التنور فاسلك فيها من كل زوجين اثنين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause ﴿جاء﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; أمرنا is the fāʿil; ﴿فار التنور﴾ is conjoined to ﴿جاء أمرنا﴾. ﴿فاسلك﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis of إذا; اسلك is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you"; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اسلك﴾; ﴿من كل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اسلك﴾; زوجين is the object of اسلك; and اثنين is a naʿt (adjective) of زوجين.
﴿وأهلك إلا من سبق عليه القول منهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أهلك is conjoined to اثنين; إلا is a particle of exception; ﴿مَن﴾ is a connected excepted, accusative (manṣūb); the clause سبق is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سبق﴾; القول is the fāʿil; and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ولا تخاطبني في الذين ظلموا إنهم مغرقون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; ﴿تخاطبني﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you"; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿في الذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تخاطبني﴾, by taking an omitted muḍāf as implied, i.e. "concerning the matter of those who"; the clause ظلموا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿إنهم مغرقون﴾ gives the reason for the prohibition of addressing (Him) about them; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and مغرقون its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿فإذا استويت أنت ومن معك على الفلك﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إذا is a future adverb, and the clause استويت is in the position of the genitive by annexation (of إذا) to it; أنت is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the tāʾ; ﴿ومَن﴾ is conjoined to the tāʾ; معك is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of من, with no grammatical position; and على الفلك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استويت﴾.
﴿فقل الحمد لله الذي نجانا من القوم الظالمين﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis of إذا; قل is an imperative verb; ﴿الحمد﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause of saying has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. الذي is an adjective (ṣifa) of الله; the clause نجانا is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position; من القوم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نجانا﴾; الظالمين is an adjective of القوم; and the clause ﴿فإذا استويت...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿وقل رب أنزلني منزلا مباركا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قل is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you"; رب is the one addressed, annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person, and the vocative particle is omitted; أنزلني is a verb of supplication, the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "You"; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿منزلا﴾ is a noun of place, a second mafʿūl bihi, or a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) substituting for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and ﴿مباركا﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿وأنت خير المنزلين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; أنت is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and خير المنزلين the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات﴾: the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ); and آيات is the noun of إن.
﴿وإن كنا لمبتلين﴾: إن is lightened from the heavy (inna), and its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); ﴿كنا﴾: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb (of kāna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); مبتلين is the khabar of كنا; the clause ﴿كنا لمبتلين﴾ is the khabar of the lightened إن; and the clause وإن كنا is conjoined to the one before it, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿ثم أنشأنا من بعدهم قرنا آخرين﴾: ثم is a conjunction for delay; أنشأنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿من بعدهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); قرنا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿آخرين﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿فأرسلنا فيهم رسولا منهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); فيهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسل﴾; ﴿رسولًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa).
﴿أن اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره أفلا تتقون﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted with what follows it as a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "with: worship…", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾; the clause ﴿اعبدوا الله﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is explicative, and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; ﴿إله﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) in position, genitive by من in form; غيره is an adjective of ﴿إله﴾ according to its position; the clause ﴿ما لكم من إله غيره﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and it functions as the reason for the command to worship. The hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ conjoins to something implied, i.e. "Do you disobey, and so not fear (Him)?"

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿وقال الملأ من قومه الذين كفروا وكذبوا بلقاء الآخرة وأترفناهم في الحياة الدنيا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قال الملأ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); من قومه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil; الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of قومه; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and what follows it is conjoined to it, falling within its scope.
﴿ما هذا إلا بشر مثلكم يأكل مما تأكلون منه ويشرب مما تشربون﴾: ما is negating; هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); بشر is the khabar (predicate); مثلكم is an adjective; the clause يأكل is a second adjective; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأكل﴾; the clause تأكلون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, i.e. "of your eating" [Translator's note: the source glosses it «من مأكولكم», literally "of what you eat"]. Likewise His saying ﴿ويشرب مما تشربون﴾, the resumptive pronoun being omitted from the second, the first resumptive pronoun, namely منه, sufficing. The whole clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿ولئن أطعتم بشرا مثلكم إنكم إذًا لخاسرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; أطعتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); بشرًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and مثلكم an adjective (ṣifa). إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), the kāf is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and خاسرون is its khabar (predicate); إذًا is a particle of response with no grammatical position. The clause إنكم لخاسرون is the response to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t: ﴿أيعدكم أنكم إذا متم وكنتم ترابا وعظاما أنكم مخرجون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the clause يعدكم is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. يعد is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). أن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is in the position of the accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi; مخرجون is its khabar (predicate); إذا is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مخرجون﴾, and the clause متم is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; ﴿وكنتم ترابًا وعظامًا﴾ is conjoined to إذا متم; and the second ﴿أنكم﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the first.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿هيهات هيهات لما توعدون﴾: هيهات is a verbal noun of the past (ism fiʿl māḍin) meaning "it is far"; the second is a verbal (lafẓī) tawkīd (emphasis) of it. The lām is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); ما is a relative noun, genitive in form by the connective lām, nominative in position as the fāʿil (agent) of the verbal noun هيهات. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is the fāʿil of هيهات.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿إن هي إلا حياتنا الدنيا نموت ونحيا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. إن is negating; ﴿هي﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); حياتنا is the khabar (predicate), and الدنيا an adjective (ṣifa); the clause ﴿نموت﴾ is circumstantial; and ﴿ونحيا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿نموت﴾.
﴿وما نحن بمبعوثين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like laysa; ﴿نحن﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿بمبعوثين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿مبعوثين﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿إن هو إلا رجل افترى على الله كذبا﴾: إن is negating; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); رجل is the khabar (predicate); the clause افترى is an adjective (ṣifa); على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿افترى﴾; ﴿كذبا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb افترى, i.e. "he invented a lie and fabricated it"; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "he invented for the sake of lying"; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "he invented while lying", and it is an emphasising ḥāl.
﴿وما نحن له بمؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like laysa; ﴿نحن﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مؤمنين﴾; ﴿بمؤمنين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿مؤمنين﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿قال رب انصرني بما كذبون﴾: رب is the one addressed, annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; انصرني is a verb of supplication; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The bāʾ is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with the agent after it [Translator's note: so in the source, «مع الفاعل بعدها»; what is meant is the verb after it] as a maṣdar genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "because of their denying me", the bāʾ thus being causal; or for substitution, i.e. "help me in exchange for their denying me"; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿انصرني﴾. The clause ﴿انصرني بما كذبون﴾ is the response to the vocative, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿رب انصرني...﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative; and the whole clause of saying ﴿قال رب...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿قال عما قليل ليصبحن نادمين﴾: ﴿عما﴾: عن is a preposition, ما is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), and قليل is genitive by ﴿عن﴾; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصبحن﴾ or to ﴿نادمين﴾. The lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; يصحبن [Translator's note: so spelled in the source, for «يصبحن»] is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb (of kāna and its sisters), nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which has been dropped because of the succession of like letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents, is its noun; the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis; and نادمين is the khabar (predicate) of يصبحن.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿فأخذتهم الصيحة بالحق فجعلناهم غثاء فبعدا للقوم الظالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿أخذتهم الصيحة﴾ is a verb, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and fāʿil (agent); ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الصيحة; فجعلناهم is conjoined to فأخذتهم, the hāʾ being the first mafʿūl bihi and غثاء the second mafʿūl bihi. The fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿بعدا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "may they be far removed", so it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the sense of an imprecation against them; ﴿للقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بعدا﴾; and الظالمين is an adjective (ṣifa) of القوم.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿ثم أنشأنا من بعدهم قرونا آخرين﴾: ثم is a conjunction (of sequence) with delay; أنشأنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿من بعدهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); قرونًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and آخرين is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿ما تسبق من أمة أجلها وما يستأخرون﴾: ما is negating; تسبق is an imperfect verb; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; أمة is genitive in form and nominative in position, because it is the fāʿil (agent) of تسبق; أجلها is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and وما يستأخرون is conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿ثم أرسلنا رسلنا تترى﴾: ثم is a conjunction (of sequence) with delay; أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); رسلنا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿تترى﴾ is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "following one another", or a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), its implied form being "a sending in succession", i.e. successive.
﴿كل ما جاء أمة رسولها كذبوه﴾: ﴿كلَّ﴾ is a substitute for an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبوه﴾ and containing the meaning of condition; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya of time; the clause ﴿جاء﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾; ﴿ما﴾ with what it enters upon is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by annexation, the implied form being "every coming", and this is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "every time of a nation's coming". Or ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite qualified by an adjective, in the sense of ﴿وقت﴾ (time), and the resumptive pronoun is omitted, the implied form being "every time in which its messenger came to a nation", so that the clause ﴿جاء﴾ is in the position of the genitive as an adjective of ﴿ما﴾. ﴿جاء﴾ is a past verb; ﴿أمة﴾ is a fronted object, and ﴿رسولها﴾ a postponed fāʿil; and the clause ﴿كذبوه﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿فأتبعنا بعضهم بعضا وجعلناهم أحاديث﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أتبعنا is a verb and its fāʿil; بعضهم is the first mafʿūl bihi, and بعضًا the second mafʿūl bihi; جعلناهم is conjoined to أتبعنا, the hāʾ being the first mafʿūl bihi and أحاديث the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فبعدا لقوم لا يؤمنون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿بعدا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "may they be far removed", so it is a maṣdar in the sense of an imprecation against them; لقوم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بعدا﴾; لا is negating; يؤمنون is a verb and its fāʿil; and the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ is in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of قوم.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿ثم أرسلنا موسى وأخاه هارون بآياتنا وسلطان مبين﴾: ثم is a conjunction (of sequence) with delay; أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); موسى is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أخاه is conjoined to it; هارون is a badal (substitute) from ﴿أخاه﴾ or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "the two of them being accompanied by Our signs", the bāʾ thus being for accompaniment (mulābasa); سلطان is conjoined to آياتنا; and مبين is an adjective (ṣifa) of سلطان.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿إلى فرعون وملئه فاستكبروا﴾: إلى فرعون is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾; ملئه is conjoined to فرعون; and فاستكبروا is conjoined to أرسلنا.
﴿وكانوا قوما عالين﴾: كان is an abrogating particle [Translator's note: so in the source, «حرف ناسخ»; كان is an abrogating verb (of kāna and its sisters)]; the wāw of the plural is its noun; قوما is its khabar (predicate); and عالين is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t: ﴿فقالوا أنؤمن لبشرين مثلنا وقومهما لنا عابدون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), the pronoun referring back to Pharaoh and his chiefs; the hamza is for interrogation; نؤمن is an imperfect verb; لبشرين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نؤمن﴾; مثلنا is an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وقومهما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; قومهما is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عابدون﴾; and عابدون is the khabar (predicate) of قومهما.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿فكذبوهما فكانوا من المهلكين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كذبوهما is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فكانوا is conjoined to كذبوهما; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb (of kāna and its sisters), and the wāw of the plural is its noun; and من المهلكين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب لعلهم يهتدون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); آتينا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); موسى is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الكتاب the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿ولقد آتينا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. لعل is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and the clause يهتدون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿وجعلنا ابن مريم وأمه آية﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; جعلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ابن مريم is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أمه is conjoined to ابن مريم; and آية is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وآويناهما إلى ربوة ذات قرار ومعين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; آويناهما is conjoined to جعلنا; إلى ربوة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آويناهما﴾; ذات is an adjective (ṣifa) of ربوة; قرار is muḍāf ilayhi; and معين is conjoined to قرار.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿يا أيها الرسل كلوا من الطيبات﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed, a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; الرسل is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; كلوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and من الطيبات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كلوا﴾.
﴿واعملوا صالحا إني بما تعملون عليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اعملوا is a verb and its fāʿil, conjoined to كلوا; صالحا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar. The clause ﴿إني﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its noun, and it gives the reason for the command; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عليم﴾; the clause تعملون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and عليم is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿وإن هذه أمتكم أمة واحدة﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); هذه is its noun and أمتكم its khabar (predicate); أمة is a permanent ḥāl (circumstantial); and واحدة is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿وأنا ربكم فاتقون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ربكم the khabar. ﴿فاتقون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); اتقون is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); and the yāʾ, dropped in accordance with the script of the Muṣḥaf, is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t: ﴿فتقطعوا أمرهم بينهم زبرا كل حزب بما لديهم فرحون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; تقطعوا is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); أمرهم is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "they split up in their affair", or it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بينهم is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقطعوا﴾; زبرًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of تقطعوا, i.e. "as factions at variance with one another"; the clause ﴿فتقطعوا أمرهم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. كل is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and حزب is muḍāf ilayhi; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فرحون﴾; لديهم is an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and فرحون is the khabar (predicate) of كل حزب.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿فذرهم في غمرتهم حتى حين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); ذرهم is an imperative verb with a latent fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "you", and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في غمرتهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "floundering in their confusion"; حتى is a particle of limit and of the genitive; حين is genitive by ﴿حتى﴾; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿ذرهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿أيحسبون أنما نمدهم به من مال وبنين﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; يحسبون is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أن and ما its noun; أن and what follows it take the place of the two objects of يحسبون; the clause نمدهم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نمدهم﴾; and ﴿من مال وبنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿نسارع لهم في الخيرات بل لا يشعرون﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أن. نسارع is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We"; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نسارع﴾; في الخيرات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); لا is negating; يشعرون is a verb and its fāʿil; and the clause ﴿بل لا يشعرون﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿إن الذين هم من خشية ربهم مشفقون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); الذين is an indeclinable relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إن; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); من خشية ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مشفقون﴾; مشفقون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; ربهم is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿هم من خشية ربهم مشفقون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿إن الذين هم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿والذين هم بآيات ربهم يؤمنون﴾: conjoined to ﴿إن الذين﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); بآيات ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمنون﴾; the clause يؤمنون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause ﴿هم بآيات ربهم يؤمنون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿والذين هم بربهم لا يشركون﴾: conjoined to ﴿إن الذين﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); بربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يشركون﴾; the clause يشركون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause ﴿هم بربهم لا يشركون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿والذين يؤتون ما آتوا وقلوبهم وجلة أنهم إلى ربهم راجعون﴾: conjoined to إن الذين; the clause يؤتون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; ما is the object of يؤتون; the clause آتوا is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿وقلوبهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; قلوبهم is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and وجلة its khabar (predicate). ﴿أنهم﴾: أن and what follows it are accusative by removal of the preposition; أن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; إلى ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿راجعون﴾; and راجعون is the khabar of أنهم.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿أولئك يسارعون في الخيرات﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن الذين هم من خشية ربهم﴾ and what is conjoined to it. أولئك is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يسارعون the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; في الخيرات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسارعون﴾.
﴿وهم لها سابقون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the one before it, serving as an emphasis of it. ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سابقون﴾; سابقون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾. The pronoun in ﴿لها﴾ refers back to the good deeds, or to Paradise, and the object of سابقون is omitted, i.e. "outstripping people to them"; or the lām is causal, i.e. "outstripping (others) for their sake".

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿ولا نكلف نفسا إلا وسعها﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. لا is negating; نكلف is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We"; نفسًا is the first object of نكلف; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and وسعها is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولدينا كتاب ينطق بالحق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لدينا is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); كتاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ينطق is an adjective (ṣifa); and بالحق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "bound up with the truth".
﴿وهم لا يظلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause لا يظلمون the khabar.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿بل قلوبهم في غمرة من هذا﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); قلوبهم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿في غمرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); ﴿من هذا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿غمرة﴾, i.e. "arising from this with which the believers have been described".
﴿ولهم أعمال من دون ذلك هم لها عاملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; أعمال is a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿من دون ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of أعمال; the clause ﴿هم﴾ is a second adjective of أعمال; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عاملون﴾; and عاملون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾, i.e. "persisting in them".

muyesser-irab:64-64.t: ﴿حتى إذا أخذنا مترفيهم بالعذاب إذا هم يجأرون﴾: حتى is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya); إذا is an adverb for future time, governing its protasis in the genitive and made accusative by its apodosis, which is ﴿يجأرون﴾; the clause أخذنا is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; نا is the fāʿil (agent); مترفيهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالعذاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخذنا﴾; the second إذا is a particle of surprise (mufājaʾa), and the clause after it is the apodosis of the first إذا, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿لا تجأروا اليوم إنكم منا لا تنصرون﴾: لا is prohibitive; تجأروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); اليوم is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تجأروا﴾. إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; the clause إنكم gives the reason for the prohibition; منا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تنصرون﴾; لا is negating; the clause تنصرون is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿قد كانت آياتي تتلى عليكم فكنتم على أعقابكم تنكصون﴾: قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿كانت آياتي﴾: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb (of kāna and its sisters), (followed by) the tāʾ of the feminine; آيات is the noun of كان, and the clause تتلى its khabar (predicate); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تتلى﴾. ﴿فكنتم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كان is a defective past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; على أعقابكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of تنكصون; and the clause تنكصون is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿مستكبرين به سامرا تهجرون﴾: مستكبرين is a second ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of تنكصون; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مستكبرين﴾, i.e. "because of it"; سامرًا is a third ḥāl; and the clause تهجرون is a fourth ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿أفلم يدبروا القول﴾: the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. The hamza is for interrogation; لم is a particle of negation, of inversion (to the past) and of the jussive; يدبروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾; القول is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted on which the hamza has entered, i.e. "Did they do what they did, of what has been mentioned before, and so not ponder the Word?"
﴿أم جاءهم ما لم يأت آباءهم الأولين﴾: أم is a conjunction in the sense of بل; ﴿جاءهم﴾ is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi; ما is a relative noun, fāʿil (agent); and the clause لم يأت آباءهم الأولين is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿أم لم يعرفوا رسولهم فهم له منكرون﴾: conjoined to what precedes; يعرفوا رسولهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿منكرون﴾; and منكرون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿أم يقولون به جنة بل جاءهم بالحق وأكثرهم للحق كارهون﴾: likewise conjoined to what precedes; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); جنة is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); بل is a particle of conjunction and of digression (iḍrāb); جاءهم is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a latent fāʿil (agent); بالحق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاءهم﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "bound up with the truth"; the wāw is circumstantial; أكثرهم is a mubtadaʾ; للحق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كارهون﴾; and كارهون is the khabar of أكثرهم.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿ولو اتبع الحق أهواءهم لفسدت السماوات والأرض ومن فيهن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. لو is conditional; ﴿اتبع الحق﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أهواءهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām occurs in the apodosis of the condition; ﴿فسدت السماوات﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿والأرض﴾ is conjoined to السماوات, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; ﴿ومَن﴾ is conjoined to السماوات; ﴿فيهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿بل أتيناهم بذكرهم﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); أتيناهم is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; and بذكرهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أتيناهم﴾.
﴿فهم عن ذكرهم معرضون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿عن ذكرهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿معرضون﴾; and معرضون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿أم تسألهم خرجا فخراج ربك خير﴾: أم is a conjunction, conjoining to ﴿أم يقولون به جنة﴾; تسألهم is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you", and (the hāʾ is) the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); خرجا is the second mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ is causal, or the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); خراج is the mubtadaʾ (subject), ربك is muḍāf ilayhi, and خير is the khabar (predicate).
﴿وهو خير الرازقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and خير the khabar; and ﴿الرازقين﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿وإنك لتدعوهم إلى صراط مستقيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); تدعوهم is an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلى صراط is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تدعوهم﴾; and مستقيم is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿وإن الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة عن الصراط لناكبون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); الذين is an indeclinable relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إن; the clause لا يؤمنون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; بالآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمنون﴾; عن الصراط is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ناكبون﴾; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ناكبون is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t: ﴿ولو رحمناهم وكشفنا ما بهم من ضر للجوا في طغيانهم يعمهون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. لو is conditional; ﴿رحمناهم﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); كشفنا is conjoined to رحمناهم; ما is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; من ضر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَلَجوا﴾: the lām links the apodosis of لو, and the clause لجوا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; في طغيانهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعمهون﴾; and the clause يعمهون is circumstantial.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t: ﴿ولقد أخذناهم بالعذاب فما استكانوا لربهم وما يتضرعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the response to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); أخذناهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالعذاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخذناهم﴾; فما استكانوا is conjoined to أخذناهم; ما is negating; استكانوا is a verb and its fāʿil; لربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استكانوا﴾; the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; and يتضرعون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t: ﴿حتى إذا فتحنا عليهم بابا ذا عذاب شديد إذا هم فيه مبلسون﴾: حتى is an inceptive particle; إذا is a conditional adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مبلسون﴾; the clause فتحنا is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فتحنا﴾; بابًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿ذا عذاب﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿بابًا﴾. The second إذا is a particle of surprise (mufājaʾa), standing in place of the fāʾ of requital in linking, and the clause after it is the apodosis of the first إذا; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مبلسون﴾; and مبلسون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿وهو الذي أنشأ لكم السمع والأبصار والأفئدة﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الذي﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); the clause أنشأ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنشأ﴾; السمع is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿الأبصار والأفئدة﴾ is conjoined to it.
﴿قليلا﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the omitted maṣdar, i.e. "you give little thanks".
﴿ما﴾: a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) to emphasise the littleness.
﴿تشكرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿قليلا ما تشكرون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t: ﴿وهو الذي ذرأكم في الأرض وإليه تحشرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الذي﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); ﴿ذرأكم﴾ is a past verb, a latent fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ذرأكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ذرأ﴾; ﴿إليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تحشرون﴾; تحشرون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿وإليه تحشرون﴾ is conjoined to ذرأكم; and the clause ﴿وهو الذي ذرأكم﴾ is conjoined to the resumptive clause ﴿وهو الذي أنشأ لكم السمع...﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿وهو الذي يحيي ويميت وله اختلاف الليل والنهار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الذي﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿يحيي﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, a clause with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿يميت﴾ is conjoined to the ṣila clause ﴿يحيي﴾, so it has no grammatical position. ﴿وله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; اختلاف is a postponed mubtadaʾ; الليل is muḍāf ilayhi; النهار is conjoined (maʿṭūf) and genitive; the clause ﴿له اختلاف الليل والنهار﴾ is conjoined to the ṣila clause ﴿يحيي﴾, so it has no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿وهو الذي يحيي...﴾ is conjoined to the resumptive clause ﴿وهو الذي أنشأ لكم السمع...﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿أفلا تعقلون﴾: ﴿أفلا﴾: the hamza: for interrogation; the fāʾ: conjoining to an implied resumptive (clause), i.e. "Do you not reflect, and so not understand?", or "Do you reflect, and yet not understand?"; لا: negating; ﴿تعقلون﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:81-81.t: ﴿بل قالوا مثل ما قال الأولون﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); مثل is an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a saying like the saying of the former ones"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted with what follows it as a maṣdar that is muḍāf ilayhi; and الأولون is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t: ﴿قالوا أئذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أئنا لمبعوثون﴾: the clause is a badal (substitute) from the clause before it, i.e. resumptive, with no grammatical position. The hamza is for interrogation; إذا is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition, and the clause متنا is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of إذا to it; كنا is conjoined to متنا; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb (of kāna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and ترابا its khabar (predicate); عظاما is conjoined to ﴿ترابًا﴾. The hamza is likewise for interrogation; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and مبعوثون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t:
﴿لقد وعدنا نحن وآباؤنا هذا من قبل﴾: the lām is the response to the omitted oath; وعد is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿نا﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); نحن is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun; آباؤنا is conjoined to the attached pronoun; هذا is in the position of the accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وعدنا﴾, or to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of His word ﴿آباؤنا﴾, i.e. "those who were before".
﴿إن هذا إلا أساطير الأولين﴾: إن is negating; هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and أساطير الأولين is the khabar (predicate) of هذا.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿قل لمن الأرض ومن فيها﴾: قل is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you"; the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿لمن﴾: the lām is a preposition, and من is interrogative; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); الأرض is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); من is a relative noun conjoined to الأرض; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿إن كنتم تعلمون﴾: إن is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause تعلمون its khabar; كنتم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "then tell me of the Creator of the two".

muyesser-irab:85-85.t: ﴿سيقولون لله قل أفلا تذكرون﴾: the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "it is"; and the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). قل is an imperative verb; the hamza is for interrogation; the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted; لا is negating; and تذكرون is an imperfect verb.

muyesser-irab:86-86.t: ﴿قل من رب السماوات السبع ورب العرش العظيم﴾: قل is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿مَن﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿رب﴾ is its khabar (predicate); السماوات is muḍāf ilayhi; السبع is a naʿt (adjective) of السماوات; and ﴿رب العرش العظيم﴾ is conjoined to it.

muyesser-irab:87-87.t: ﴿سيقولون لله قل أفلا تتقون﴾: ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: "Say: To whom do the seven heavens belong?" [Translator's note: so in the source; the implied form given restates the question rather than the answer, i.e. "they (belong) to Allah"]. ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb; the hamza is for interrogation; the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted; لا is negating; and تتقون is an imperfect verb.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿قل من بيده ملكوت كل شيء﴾: من is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿بيده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ملكوت is a postponed mubtadaʾ; كل شيء is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is the khabar of من.
﴿وهو يجير ولا يجار عليه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يجير﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar; and the clause ﴿يجار﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يجير﴾.
﴿إن كنتم تعلمون﴾: إن is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb (of kāna and its sisters), the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause تعلمون its khabar; كنتم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "if you know, then tell me".

muyesser-irab:89-89.t: ﴿سيقولون لله﴾: ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: "Say: Who has the dominion of all things?" [Translator's note: so in the source; the implied form given restates the question rather than the answer]. ﴿قل فأنى تسحرون﴾: ﴿فأنى﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); أنى is an interrogative noun meaning "how", in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); تسحرون is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause فأنى تسحرون is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:90-90.t: ﴿بل أتيناهم بالحق وإنهم لكاذبون﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; أتيناهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالحق is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the wāw is circumstantial; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and كاذبون is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:91-91.t:
﴿ما اتخذ الله من ولد وما كان معه من إله﴾: ما is negating; اتخذ الله is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; ولد is genitive in form and accusative in position, because it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb (of kāna and its sisters); معه is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is a connective preposition; and ﴿إله﴾ is genitive in form and nominative in position, because it is the noun of كان.
﴿إذا لذهب كل إله بما خلق﴾: إذًا is a particle of response and requital, inoperative; the lām occurs in the apodosis of the implied condition ﴿لو﴾; ذهب كل is a verb and its fāʿil, and إله is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ذهب﴾; and the clause خلق is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولعلا بعضهم على بعض﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿سبحان الله عما يصفون﴾: سبحان: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb; the Name of Majesty (Allah) is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿عما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سبحان﴾; the clause يصفون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and it and what follows it are interpreted as a genitive maṣdar, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿سبحان﴾.

nahhas-irab:1-1.t: Whoever reads «قَدَ افْلَحَ» «[Translator's note: the printed text gives the word as «(قد أفلح)» without the vowelling that distinguishes this reading; the explanation shows it is the reading transferring the hamza's vowel to the dāl.]» threw the vowel of the hamza onto the dāl and dropped the hamza, because the dāl was vowelless; when the hamza is lightened it comes close to [producing] two vowelless letters, so the hamza was dropped for this reason, and then its vowel was thrown onto the dāl.

nahhas-irab:2-2.t: (الَّذِينَ) is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of «المؤمنين». (هُمْ فِي صَلاتِهِمْ خاشِعُونَ) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate), included in the ṣila (relative clause); and likewise what follows it.

nahhas-irab:3-3.t: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk said: «اللغو» is shirk (associating partners with Allah). Abū Jaʿfar said: «اللغو» in the language is what ought to be cancelled (يُلغى), that is, discarded. Among the best of what has been said about it is the view of al-Ḥasan: it is all sins. This is a comprehensive view that includes the view of whoever said it is shirk and the view of whoever said it is singing — as Mālik ibn Anas related from Muḥammad ibn al-Munkadir «[Translator's note: the printed text has «محمد بن المنذر».]» that Allah, Majestic and Mighty, will say on the Day of Resurrection: "Where are those who kept themselves and their hearing clear of idle amusement and the flutes of the devils? Admit them into the meadows of musk." Then He will say to the angels: "Let them hear My praise and My laudation, and tell them that (لا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ)."

nahhas-irab:4-4.t: So Allah, Majestic and Mighty, praised whoever pays the zakat from his wealth, even if he pays nothing else from it. So it is as if those who hoard gold and silver are those who do not pay the zakat.

nahhas-irab:5-6.t: (وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حافِظُونَ (5) إِلاَّ عَلى أَزْواجِهِمْ أَوْ ما مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ) (6): al-Farrāʾ said: that is, "except from their wives", whom Allah, Majestic and Mighty, has made lawful for them — four, not exceeding [that]. (أَوْ ما مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُهُمْ): [«ما»] is in the position of genitive, conjoined to «أزواجهم», and «ما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun).

nahhas-irab:7-7.t: He, Majestic and Mighty, has informed [us] that He does not love the transgressors; and if He does not love them, He hates them and is hostile to them; there is no middle ground in that.

nahhas-irab:8-8.t: The Meccans read «لأمانتِهم» in the singular. Abū Jaʿfar said: «أمانة» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) that serves for both singular and plural; if you mean different kinds, the plural and the singular are both permissible, except that the plural is good here, because Allah, Majestic and Mighty, has entrusted the servants with many things, among them ablution, the major ritual bath, prayer, fasting and others. As for Abū ʿUbayd's argument for his choice of «لأماناتهم» from His saying (إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَنْ تُؤَدُّوا الْأَماناتِ إِلى أَهْلِها) [al-Nisāʾ: 58], it is rejected: this does not resemble that, because «الأمانات» there are the actual things themselves, like deposits, and this is not like that. Do you not see that after it comes (وَعَهْدِهِمْ), and He did not say «وعهودهم»? So the plural and the singular are both permissible.

nahhas-irab:10-10.t:
(أُولئِكَ) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «هم» is a second mubtadaʾ, or, if you wish, it is a separating pronoun (fāṣila). (الْوارِثُونَ), on the view that «هم» is a fāṣila, is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك»; on the other view it is the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the khabar of «أولئك». Al-Zuhrī related from ʿUrwa from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAbd al-Qārī from ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, may Allah be pleased with him, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: "Ten verses have been sent down to me; whoever upholds them will enter Paradise." Then he recited (قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ) up to ten verses. Abū Jaʿfar said: the meaning of "whoever upholds them" is whoever adheres to them, does not contravene what is in them, and fulfils it, as you say: "So-and-so attends to his work." Then, after these verses, the obligation of fasting and pilgrimage was revealed and entered along with them.
Those who read «لأماناتهم» read (فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظاماً فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظامَ لَحْماً), except ʿĀṣim, who read «فخلقنا المضغة عَظْماً فكسونا العَظْمَ لحماً» «[Translator's note: the printed text has «العظام» in ʿĀṣim's variant; the singular reading has «العَظْمَ» in both places.]»; and likewise read al-Aʿraj, Qatāda and ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir. The first reading is good and clear, because the lump of flesh separates and becomes bones, so the plural is clearer in this; the singular is permissible, serving for the plural. Abū Isḥāq said about the reason for its permissibility: because it is known that a human being has bones. Abū ʿUbayd chose the plural and argued from the saying of Allah, Majestic and Mighty, (وَانْظُرْ إِلَى الْعِظامِ كَيْفَ نُنْشِزُها) [al-Baqara: 259], that is, because they agreed on this. This comparison is a mistake, because since the lump of flesh separates into bones, each part of it is a bone, so each one of them serves for its fellow; whereas «وانظر إلى العظام» is not like that, because that is a pointing to a plurality, and if you mentioned a singular the pointing would be to a single one. (ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْناهُ خَلْقاً آخَرَ) is figurative (majāz), and (خَلْقاً) is a maṣdar (verbal noun), because the meaning of «أنشأناه» is «خلقناه». The singular of «الطرائق» is «طريقة».

nahhas-irab:20-20.t: (وَشَجَرَةً) is conjoined to (جَنَّاتٍ) [verse 19]. Al-Farrāʾ allowed the nominative, because the verb is not expressed, in the sense «وثَمَّ شجرةٌ» (and there is a tree). (تَخْرُجُ مِنْ طُورِ سَيْناءَ), with fatḥa on the sīn, is the reading of the Kufans, on the pattern «فَعْلاء». «فَعْلاء» is common in speech; it is barred from full inflection (diptote) both when definite and when indefinite, because at its end is the alif of the feminine, and the alif of the feminine is inseparable from what it is in. But there is no «فِعْلاء» in speech; so whoever reads «سِيناء» with kasra on the sīn made it «فِعْلال», and barred it from full inflection on the basis that it is [the name] of a place. Al-Akhfash said: it is a foreign noun. We have already mentioned «تُنْبِتُ» and «تَنْبُتُ».

nahhas-irab:29-29.t: [«مُنْزَلاً»] «[Translator's note: the printed entry begins abruptly; the first word, evidently «مُنْزَلاً» with ḍamma on the mīm, has dropped out.]» is a maṣdar (verbal noun), and «مَنْزِلاً» with fatḥa on the mīm means "make for me a place to alight". Abū Isḥāq said: whoever reads «مَنْزَلاً» with fatḥa on the mīm and the zāy «[Translator's note: the printed text vowels the word in the standard way, «مُنْزَلًا».]» makes it a maṣdar of «نَزَلَ نُزولاً ومَنْزَلاً» (to alight).

nahhas-irab:33-33.t: Al-Farrāʾ claimed that the meaning of (وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ) is with «منه» omitted, that is, «ويشرب مما تشربون منه». This is not permissible according to the Basrans, and there is no need for any omission at all, because when «ما» is maṣdariyya it needs no resumptive pronoun; and if you make it in the sense of «الذي» and omit the object, there is still no need to imply «مِن». Abū Jaʿfar said: We have already discussed (أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذا مِتُّمْ) in a way that needs nothing more.

nahhas-irab:36-36.t: (هَيْهاتَ هَيْهاتَ لِما تُوعَدُونَ) (36): it has been read in three ways. The people of the two Sanctuaries and the people of Kufa read (هَيْهاتَ هَيْهاتَ) with fatḥa and without tanwīn, except Abū Jaʿfar, who read «هيهاتِ هيهاتِ» with kasra and without tanwīn; and ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar read «هيهاتٍ هيهاتٍ» with kasra and tanwīn. These are three readings. Abū Jaʿfar said: «هيهاتاً هيهاتاً», with fatḥa and tanwīn, is also permissible. «[Translator's note: the printed text vowels all of these forms like the standard reading; they are given here as the descriptions specify.]» Al-Kisāʾī said: many people among the Arabs say «أيهات», that is, they substitute a hamza for the hāʾ; and in it are permissible all the dialectal forms permissible in «هيهات». Abū Jaʿfar said: whoever says «هيهاتَ هيهاتَ لما توعدون» pauses with the hāʾ, according to Sībawayh and al-Kisāʾī, and nothing else, because it is a singular. It is indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa and its position is nominative, because the meaning is "remoteness"; since no verb is derived from it, it is like the particles, and fatḥa was chosen for it because it contains the hāʾ of the feminine, so it is like a noun joined to a noun, as in «خمسة عشر» (fifteen). Al-Farrāʾ claimed that the pause on it is with the yāʾ «[Translator's note: thus in the printed text; possibly a misprint for "with the tāʾ".]». Whoever gives it kasra pauses with the tāʾ, according to all, whether he gives it tanwīn or not, because it is a plural like «بيضات», its singular being «هَيْهة» like «بيضة»; and the accusative of the plural is like its genitive. On the tanwīn there are two views: one is that the tanwīn in the feminine plural is inseparable; the other is that it differentiates between definite and indefinite; for this reason whoever dropped it did so on the basis that he made it definite. One says «هيهاتَ لما قلتَ» and «هيهاتَ ما قلتَ», that is, "remoteness for what you said" and "far-off is what you said".

nahhas-irab:40-40.t: (قالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ): «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), for emphasis, according to the Basrans.

nahhas-irab:44-44.t: (ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنا رُسُلَنا تَتْرا): there are three readings of it. The Kufans, Nāfiʿ, al-Ḥasan and Ibn Muḥayṣin read (تَتْرا) without tanwīn; Abū ʿAmr, Abū Jaʿfar and al-Aʿraj read «تَتْراً» with tanwīn; and «تِتْرى», with kasra on the first tāʾ, is permissible. «[Translator's note: the printed text vowels all three forms like the standard reading; they are given here as the descriptions specify.]» Its position is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), because the meaning of «ثم أرسلنا» is «ثم واترنا» (then We sent in succession); it may also be in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), that is, "sending in succession". Al-Aṣmaʿī said: «واترتُ كتبي عليه» means I made them follow one another, but with an interval between each one and the next. Others among the lexicographers said: «المواترة» is succession without interval. Abū Jaʿfar said: whoever reads «تترى» without tanwīn makes it «فَعْلى», like «سكرى»; whoever gives it tanwīn makes the alif [the sign] of the accusative, as you say «رأيتُ زيداً يا هذا». In both readings the tāʾ is a substitute for a wāw, as one says «تالله» and «والله». It is from «واترتُ», and its derivation is from «الوِتْر» and «الوَتْر» (odd number). (وَجَعَلْناهُمْ أَحادِيثَ): their story is told, wondered at, and taken as a lesson. (فَبُعْداً) is a maṣdar, that is, Allah, Majestic and Mighty, removed them far from the reward of the Hereafter.

nahhas-irab:50-50.t: (وَآوَيْناهُما إِلى رَبْوَةٍ): it is also said with kasra and fatḥa [«رِبْوة», «رَبْوة»]. In its sense one also says «رُباوة», and Ibn Abī Isḥāq read it so; and one says «رَباوة» and «رِباوة», with fatḥa and kasra. «[Translator's note: the printed text does not mark the vowels of these forms; they are supplied according to the descriptions.]» The best of what has been said about it is what Ibn ʿAbbās, may Allah have mercy on him, said. He said: "I have been informed that it is Damascus", because his saying "I have been informed" indicates that it is [based on] transmission (tawqīf).

nahhas-irab:51-51.t: (يا أَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ): [«الرسل»] is a naʿt (adjective) of «أيّ». (كُلُوا مِنَ الطَّيِّباتِ): al-Ḥasan said: that is, from what is lawful.
